#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The backup destination can be supplied as the first argument or via the
# DEST environment variable.  It may be an scp-style remote path (host:path)
# or a local/mount path.
DEST="${1:-${DEST:-}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination not set (use \$1 or DEST=host:path / /mount/path)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp -q "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
